label: K-Breathe
description: Displays live breathing data from the Tymewear VitalPro sensor on your Karoo. Includes VE, breathing rate, tidal volume, mobilization index, VE graph, and time-in-zones fields with FIT recording.
releaseNotes: Reliability overhaul: scan-assisted initial connect for contested BLE radios (pingyijin's 8-device scenario), HIGH connection priority to survive radio starvation, foreground service to keep BLE alive across ride-start (thomasbrunner-spec freeze fix), decoded GATT/scan status codes in logs, time-to-first-packet diagnostics. Debounced service lifecycle avoids restart races on rapid reconnect.
